scope.node set: as specified: 12965 table knots and their mirrors, 1517 composite nodes, positive torus knots with pq <= 60 and mirrors, 2268 cable nodes (companions with at most 8 crossings, s in {2,3}, |r| <= P_cab = 15)
scope.diagrams: at most 11 crossings: KnotInfo PD code, braid closure(s) of KnotInfo braid word(s), 3 seeded re-diagrams (specification value). 12-13 crossings: KnotInfo PD code and braid closure, 0 re-diagrams (shrunk from 3). Torus knots: braid closure and 1 re-diagram
scope.crossing changes: at most 11 crossings: every crossing of all 5 diagrams of every prime knot and of the composites with crossing sum <= 9. 12-13 crossings: every crossing of the KnotInfo PD diagram (braid-closure diagrams for the first 31 of 305 shards only). Torus knots: braid-closure diagrams. Mirror nodes: not recomputed (implied by F3/C3/U4b)
scope.twists: k_max shrunk from 6/5/4 to: k = 2 and k = 3 on the KnotInfo PD diagram of every prime knot with at most 11 crossings; k = 3 on the PD diagrams of part of the 12-crossing knots (time-boxed, see pass progress); k = 4 on prime knots with at most 8 crossings (probe); |a-b| <= 2 and both handednesses throughout; no twists on braid closures, re-diagrams, 13-crossing, composite, torus or cable diagrams
scope.mutations: every diagrammatic Conway circle, three rotations: PD and braid-closure diagrams for at most 11 crossings, PD diagrams for 12-13 crossings; composites with crossing sum <= 9
scope.slope set: X1/X3 (all nodes): |p| <= 30, q <= 4 (specification), plus integers |p| <= 60 for torus knots and the S3/S4 slopes for cables. Fillings actually built: |p| <= 30, q <= 4 for prime knots with at most 11 crossings; |p| <= 30, q <= 2 for 12 crossings; |p| <= 30, q = 1 for 13 crossings; torus slope set for torus knots; none for composites and cables (S3/S4 need no recognition)
scope.recognition time limit: 1.5 s per filling (at most 11 crossings), 0.3 s (12 crossings), 0.2 s (13 crossings), 0.5 s for torus-knot fillings (shrunk from 60 s); enforced inside the Regina retriangulation search instead of a subprocess; each node is processed by a worker that is replaced if it crashes or exceeds 25 minutes
scope.coincidence certificates: candidates are fillings with equal |p| and volume within 2e-7; verification (verify_hyperbolicity) and the verified isometry signature are computed only for candidates, in priority order (clusters containing a node with pinned r_2 or r_0 first) under a time budget; self-coincidences p/q, -p/q of amphichiral knots are skipped because their equations are implied by F5/C5
scope.peripheral nodes: a result that is not a core node is instantiated as a node only if it is reached from two distinct core nodes or a homogeneous diagram of it was found; other identified results are counted (parameters.json, stats) but not instantiated; unidentified results are discarded
scope.calculator: KnotInfo PD codes of all table knots; construction diagrams of composites, torus knots and family constructions; cable diagrams with at most 40 crossings (10 s limit); instantiated peripheral nodes (30 s limit); complexes (milestone 7) only for nodes whose upsilon was not pinned
scope.identification: Regina solid-torus test only when the Alexander polynomial is trivial; Regina isosig matching of non-hyperbolic results against the pool of torus knots, composites, family constructions and small cables with a bounded retriangulation search
